scope: Genomically expressed membrane abscission versus autonomously reproduced hereditary division capacity

sources.authors: Sharma, Nafar, Kerssemakers, Fernández, Koenderink, Dekker
sources.status: preprint July 22, 2026; not peer-reviewed; no independent replication confirmed
sources.grade: E2-depth indexed original main Results/Methods/Discussion; supplementary raw traces and all independent preparation counts not reanalyzed
sources.rights: bioRxiv original version licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; review paraphrases only
sources.positive: DNA template yields functional DynA protein in supplied PURE-containing pre-deformed GUVs; FRAP analysis reports 27% full scission and 15% hemi-scission among 26 necks from three preparations; D1 domain yields 21% full and 17% hemi-scission among 24 necks in two preparations
sources.negative_controls: Remaining 58% DynA necks open; high DOPG needed to mitigate aggregation; cell-free reaction mixture lowers purified-DynA scission rate vs optimized non-PURE conditions; preshaped GUVs required
sources.method_unit: assayed membrane necks vs independent preps vs initial vesicles, not parent-offspring pedigrees
sources.missing_heredity: No end-to-end multigeneration whole-genome inheritance, offspring re-expression or net descendant fitness after withdrawal of operator-prescribed stages

sources.authors: De Franceschi, Barth, Meindlhumer, Fragasso, Dekker
sources.status: peer-reviewed journal original published online October 5 2023, issue 2024
sources.program: TU Delft / Dekker purified DynA, same program as P41-S1
sources.grade: E2 selected original publisher abstract/results figure and controls, not entire original SI audited
sources.rights: Original Nature Nanotechnology reuse license not verified beyond publisher exclusive-license notice; critical paraphrase only
sources.positive: Purified externally supplied DynA localizes to necks and enables hemi/full membrane scission in reshaped liposomes
sources.negative_controls: Lacks genomic expression in descendants, whole-cell regeneration and fully autonomous division cycles
sources.method_unit: externally reshaped liposome necks and FRAP; same lab as Sharma 2026
sources.missing_heredity: No encoded multigeneration inherited division program

sources.status: peer-reviewed Nature Communications original published March 6 2026
sources.program: Max Planck / Schwille FtsZ ring constriction; independent of Dekker but distinct mechanism
sources.grade: E2 accessible original main Results/Methods/Discussion; supplement/source data not independently analyzed
sources.rights: Original CC BY 4.0 with third-party material exclusions; citations/paraphrase only
sources.positive: cytoFtsN promotes large closed FtsZ rings (~10.9 micrometers) and progressive near-complete vesicle constriction
sources.negative_controls: FtsZ alone ~0.4-micrometer rings and no comparable global deformation; GTP-only bundles aggregate; no full scission reported
sources.method_unit: more than 90 surveyed vesicles and 14 diameter-tracked vesicles, not independent daughter lineages
sources.missing_heredity: No full membrane abscission, genome inheritance, functional daughter expression or autonomous reproduction
